Removing

Refitting

- Proceed as follows to remove the left rear coil spring.

- Position the vehicle on a lift.

Op. 4450B06 LEFT REAR WHEEL R R

1. Position a hydraulic lift under the rear axle.

- Loosen the bolts fixing the shock absorber.

2. Using the hydraulic lift, release the lower fixing bolt and remove it.

- Lower the hydraulic lift until the coil spring is completely released.

1. Compress the coil spring and extract it.
- Proceed in the same way to remove the right rear coil spring.

Refitting

Removing

- Proceed as follows to refit the left rear coil spring.

- Fit the coil spring in the housing between the rear axle and the bodyshell.

- Use the hydraulic lift and fit the lower shock absorber fixing bolt.

- Tighten the shock absorber fixing bolts to the recommended torque.
